'''Sone''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]], the daughter of [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] and an [[unidentified Clawdite]] on [[Denon/Legends|Denon]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Eventually, her mother found life on a single world too restrictive and left their family to pursue a career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> Following her mother's [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Sone disappeared.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
